Subject: Kicking off annual retainer funding planning

Hi Rafael —

We're getting ready to finalize the annual retainer with Redwood for FY27. Our procurement team asked whether we can split the upfront deposit into three authorized drawdown tranches tied to milestone windows across the year rather than a single upfront invoice. We also need to confirm tax/VAT handling for EU/UK spend and whether Redwood can provide country-level tax evidence for ledger reconciliation.

Can you propose a high-level invoice authorization cadence and tell me what tax docs you need from us? I can loop in our procurement lead (billing@brightpathhealth.com) if helpful.

Thanks,
Sara Lindstrom
Director, Finance Operations
BrightPath Health

Sara —

Thanks, this is great context. We can absolutely support a phased authorization model. High-level proposal: 3 tranches (40% / 35% / 25%) tied to Q1 kick, mid-year capacity review, and final renewal checkpoint. Each tranche will be invoiced with a 30-day payment term and a drawdown authorization that your procurement signs to release the funds.

For tax/VAT evidence we typically need: a completed W-9 (US) or VAT registration and local tax contact (EU/UK). If you have a consolidated tax worksheet that shows country splits, that helps our finance team map invoices to ledger buckets.

I'll run this by our collections and tax leads. Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether BrightPath needs any custom PO or invoice numbering?

—Rafael
